description: This Java class handles the command for posting interest to a fixed deposit account in the Fineract system. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and is annotated to handle 'POSTINTEREST' actions on 'FIXEDDEPOSITACCOUNT' entities. The class uses dependency injection for the service that performs the core business logic.

classes.name: PostInterestFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles command to post interest on a fixed deposit account, implementing processing logic via the depositAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: PostInterestFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the deposit account write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command by invoking the service to post interest for the specified fixed deposit account.
